Millbrook’s growth from 2020 to 2025 was:

\[
\frac{37,203-34,590}{34,590}=\frac{2,613}{34,590}
\]

Applying the same percentage growth to 2030:

\[
37,203 \times \left(1+\frac{2,613}{34,590}\right)=40,013.3819\ldots
\]

Rounded to 0 decimal places, the projected population is **40,013**, so it would exceed 40,000.
